value.behaviour: The five page actions: create, switch, rename, reorder and delete, registered through register().
rules: 1. Export a helper getPageSwitchAppState(appState, targetPageId): Partial<AppState> that stores { scrollX, scrollY, zoom } of appState.activePageId into pageViewports, removes the target's entry and applies it (or scrollX 0, scrollY 0, zoom { value: 1 as NormalizedZoomValue }), sets activePageId = targetPageId, and resets selectedElementIds {}, selectedGroupIds {}, editingGroupId null, selectedLinearElement null, editingTextElement null, croppingElementId null, activeEmbeddable null, searchMatches kept as is.

2. actionCreatePage (name "createPage", label "pages.createPage", trackEvent { category: "canvas" }, viewMode false, predicate !appState.viewModeEnabled): page = newPage({ name: t("pages.defaultName", { number: getNonDeletedPages(appState.pages).length + 1 }), pages: appState.pages }); returns appState { ...getPageSwitchAppState(appState, page.id), pages: sortPages([...appState.pages, page]) }, captureUpdate NEVER.

3. actionSwitchPage (name "switchPage", label "pages.switchPage", viewMode true, trackEvent false): formData is the target page id; returns false when it equals appState.activePageId or names no non-deleted page; else appState getPageSwitchAppState(...), captureUpdate NEVER.

4. actionRenamePage (name "renamePage", label "pages.renamePage", viewMode false, trackEvent false): formData { pageId, name }; trimmed = name.trim(); returns false when trimmed is empty, the page is missing/deleted, or trimmed equals the current name; else pages with updatePage(page, { name: trimmed }), captureUpdate NEVER.

5. actionReorderPage (name "reorderPage", label "pages.reorderPage", viewMode false, trackEvent false): formData { pageId, toPosition } (position among non-deleted pages after removal); returns false when the page is missing or the position is unchanged; else pages = sortPages(pages with updatePage(page, { index: getReorderedPageIndex(appState.pages, pageId, toPosition) })), captureUpdate NEVER.

6. actionDeletePage (name "deletePage", label "pages.deletePage", viewMode false, trackEvent { category: "canvas" }, predicate getNonDeletedPages(appState.pages).length > 1 && !appState.viewModeEnabled): formData pageId (default appState.activePageId); returns false when one non-deleted page remains or the page is missing/deleted. Elements: options = getScenePageOptions(appState.pages, appState.activePageId); every non-deleted element of app.scene.getElementsIncludingDeleted() with getElementPageId(el, options) === pageId becomes newElementWith(el, { isDeleted: true }); others unchanged. Pages: updatePage(page, { isDeleted: true }). When pageId is the active page, neighbour = next non-deleted page in order, else previous, and spread getPageSwitchAppState(appState, neighbour.id). Returns { elements, allPages: true, appState, captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY }.
7. Labels and names are i18n keys only; no string literals shown to the user.

rules: 1. syncScenePage(): this.scene.setActivePage(getScenePageOptions(this.state.pages, this.state.activePageId)); called first in render() and right before every replaceAllElements that follows a page-data change (syncActionResult with allPages, updateScene with appState.pages or appState.activePageId).

5. updateScene: when appState carries pages or activePageId, call this.scene.setActivePage(getScenePageOptions(appState.pages ?? this.state.pages, appState.activePageId ?? this.state.activePageId)) before replacing elements; stamp elements whose id is not in this.scene.getElementsMapIncludingDeleted() with stampElementsPage only when captureUpdate is given, is not CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER and appState?.pages is undefined (a call carrying appState.pages is a whole-scene load, e.g. excalidraw-app onHashChange, and keeps every element's pageId as given).
